blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Poplar was little changed, 28 in June and 28 in October (+0.0%), and 9 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 6.8% of Abbotsford’s 410 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Poplar?
Poplar also had 26 condos and townhomes listed and 7 sold in October, against 28 houses listed. The Poplar condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Poplar home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

18 houses sold in Poplar with a median price of $925,000 (the middle half sold between $869,250 and $1,048,250), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $408 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median lot of 7,327 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Poplar?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 28 houses listed in Poplar. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Poplar a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Poplar had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Poplar from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 9 houses sold in Poplar over those 5 months, out of 287 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Poplar?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Poplar sell for?
faq.a: 18 houses sold in Poplar between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $925,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Poplar?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.7% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
